desc: Co-op: player 2's partner Vivian (her shadow) hops, and the partner's field ability (X from player 2) is used in the middle of a hop, Mario's player ends it (B), then the hops go on: every hop ends (landed, or a hop the ability cut short falls to the ground), none is left in the air or in the jump pose. Rogueport's plaza, Mario put at 240 0 20. Shots: after_ability (once the ability is over), after (the last hops, standing)
log_must: player 2's character: hop ends, the partner's ability begins
